title: Encoded prefix slice
statement: Given natural numbers $a,k$ and an encoded pair of Boolean lists $z$, decode its first and second components as $x$ and $y$. Take the first $a(|x|+1)^k$ entries of $y$, then encode the pair consisting of $x$ and that prefix.
